budget_and_time.observability_finding: The static task_timeout_s=3600 limit is exposed, but every explicit budget() result contains only call counts. Existing CallBudget has the authoritative monotonic deadline; snapshot() omits it. Root repeatedly requested/printed the snapshot, including 78 calls remaining with retrospectively 12.161948 seconds until worker timeout.
budget_and_time.behavior_limit: The agent could measure elapsed time using Python, but no explicit clock/elapsed-time calls occur in the 17 executed blocks. This supports missing requested time observability, not absolute inability to read a clock.
budget_and_time.strategy_evidence: Continued supplementary research and multi-institution evidence reconciliation through turns15–16; finalturn17 searched all retained documents by surname and built five broad payloads, causing two provider input-limit rejections. No answer-ready assignment executed.
budget_and_time.general_correction_supported: Expose finite nonnegative seconds_remaining from the existing monotonic deadline in explicit budget() snapshots and describe it in the static contract. Preserve all limits, scheduling, retries and agent choice. No counterfactual success guarantee.
